---
title: "Capability documentation standard"
---

Every admitted capability should have module-local documentation. This refresh found **218 Markdown documents** and **147 XLSForms** under the current module `docs/` directories and mirrors them into the searchable source library.

## Minimum per capability

```text
docs/README_<Capability>.md
docs/example_odk_<capability>.xlsx
```

Recommended supporting files include `VALIDATION.md`, `ROADMAP_NOTE.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `ATTRIBUTION.md`.

A capability README should cover purpose, method ID, lane/status, native UX, preset behaviour, ODK behaviour, settings/runtime inputs, outputs, core result, audit/full-JSON fields, media rules, permissions, offline/online behaviour, dependencies, examples, validation and attribution/licensing.

Documentation must explicitly state that dashboard is one projection and identify how each individual capability remains exposed for direct native use, presets, protocols and ODK/XLSForm.

## Authority

Module docs describe capability-local implementation. They do not override the Master Book's architecture doctrine. Roadmap and patch notes are evidence/context, not automatically current requirements.
